input_files.rule: Task/project/CWD, instruction/configuration evidence, relevant skill metadata, selected bodies, read references and supplied prompts. Audit-time reads do not prove original loading; defaults do not prove effective configuration.

contracts.output contract: Evidence-first findings with source/authority, impact, proposed diff and uncertainty; or authorized scoped changes with preservation and passed/failed/skipped checks. AGENTS and code_map decisions are independent. Planning approval alone does not authorize implementation.
contracts.rollback boundary: All package behavior is local prompt, reference, metadata, fixture, and report content. Repository guidance edits remain limited to the caller-authorized files; user-global and external writes are outside the default boundary.

intent.job_to_be_done: Audit and improve task-relevant Codex context while preserving verified constraints and authorization.
inputs: Relevant skill metadata, loaded bodies/references and task prompts
outputs: Prioritized source-grounded audit and proposed diffs
Authorized local changes and honest validation
exclusions: General Codex setup, model/API migration and plugin recommendations
Claude-only guidance and ordinary code review
Unrequested global changes, installation, publishing and history scans
